title: Nalgene 32oz Wide Mouth Bottle — product specifications
claims: The 32 oz Wide Mouth bottle holds 32 oz, weighs 6.25 oz (177.25 g), stands 8.25 in (21 cm) high, has a 3.5 in (89 mm) diameter and a 2.5 in (63 mm) cap diameter, uses Tritan Renew material, and is made in the USA.
The wide opening fits most filtration devices and ice cubes; continuous straight semi-buttress threads provide the leak-proof guarantee; the bottle is dishwasher safe and BPA/BPS free.
